racine: paths are relative to the PARENT folder of MedicalRecord (it contains MedicalRecord/, doc3D-renderer/ and synthetic_invoice_generator/)

prerequis.note: 11 of the 14 sets come from two neighbouring repositories, which version NEITHER their images NOR the ground truth: only the code is there. Rebuilding those sets means replaying the generation (LaTeX, then Blender).

multipage_test.titre: 8 invoices, 17 warped pages, a single template
multipage_test.role: historical reference set, the source of all the early figures

multipage_flat_1800.role: high-resolution control: the reading ceiling without warping

multipage_test_noillum.role: separates the effect of lighting from the effect of warping

multipage_test_unwarped.titre: 17 pages flattened using the UV ground truth
multipage_test_unwarped.role: dewarping oracle: the ceiling if unwarping were perfect

multipage_test_preprocessed_v3.titre: 17 pages through the pre-processing module (current version)
multipage_test_preprocessed_v3.role: the 'pre-processed' branch of the with/without comparison

variants_flat.role: diversified set: measures how much the chain depends on the template

variants_warped.role: the flat/warped pair isolates the effect of warping alone

variants_encombre.titre: the same pages, on a cluttered background (3 to 6 distractor sheets)

variants_encombre_recadre_contenu.titre: cluttered set cropped to the largest table box (x1.2)
variants_encombre_recadre_contenu.role: closed avenue: isolates the table but cuts the header (fonds_encombres section 18)

batch1.role: volume set from the earliest trials, one page per invoice

handwriting_en.role: English HTR benchmark, with measurable font variation

handwriting_gan.titre: 20 PHCN forms filled with GAN-generated handwriting (WriteViT, one real VNOnDB writer per document)
handwriting_gan.role: the final deliverable of the internship. Paired one-for-one with handwriting_vi: same text, same layout, only the handwriting differs, which is what makes the -37.7 point drop attributable to the handwriting itself -- see docs/notion_final_report.md section 7.6

handwriting_vi_warped.titre: handwritten VN forms projected on curved meshes (Blender)
handwriting_vi_warped.role: 3D deformation on handwriting -- docs/notion_deformation_3d.md; the first handwriting set to carry UV masks

tabrecset_sample.role: the project's only REAL photographs, used as a sanity check

degradation.titre: 24 degradation steps x 8 pages (blur, noise, jpeg, exposure, resolution)
degradation.role: robustness curve against photo quality -- docs/degradation.md

handwriting_vi_degradation.titre: 24 degradation steps x 3 handwritten VN specimens
handwriting_vi_degradation.role: does handwriting break earlier than printed invoices?

handwriting_en_degradation.titre: 24 degradation steps x 3 handwritten EN specimens
handwriting_en_degradation.role: same question in English, where the baseline is 99.1%
